source: SurfaceFlinger --latency sampled from external presentation layer
caveats: The latency dump is a rolling history, so rows overlap and are deduplicated by timestamp.
The collector stopped at about 580 seconds although the structured playback window was about 1198 seconds.
Invalid sentinel timestamps and collector gaps are excluded from interval statistics; observed long gaps are not independently attributed to display drops.
This measures SurfaceFlinger timestamps, not optical photon latency.
